# AudioVisualizer

> Audio visualization with waveform, line envelope, and frequency bar alternatives. Choose the implementation that fits your audio data.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `audio-visualizer` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/audio-visualizer.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/audio-visualizer.md`.

## Registry dependencies

- `core`
- `motion`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/audio-visualizer-knobs`: `audioVisualizerKnobs`, types `AudioVisualizerKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/lib/audio-visualizer-levels`: `audioVisualizerPointCount`, `normalizeAudioLevel`, `audioVisualizerHistory`, `audioVisualizerBands`
- `@/components/control-ui/audio-visualizer`: `AudioVisualizer`, types `AudioVisualizerProps`

## Composition

### Levels-driven visualizer

Waveform and line envelope alternatives read amplitude history. Frequency bars read spectrum bands and add alignment, mirroring, idle, and loading options. Each alternative has its own install and import.

```tsx
<AudioVisualizer />
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { AudioVisualizer } from "@/components/control-ui/audio-visualizer";
import { AudioVisualizerDemo } from "@/src/registry/examples/control-ui/audio-visualizer-demo";

export function AudioVisualizerExample() {
  return <AudioVisualizerDemo Visualizer={AudioVisualizer} />;
}
```

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### audio-visualizer

- `--cui-audio-visualizer-bar-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 1)`
